identity_note: ideas show IDEA000023 describes degree modifiers over an adjacent property, while hc6_antecedent_availability proposes reference forms and local antecedents. They must not be treated as the same proposal without an explicit identity correction.
logical_assessment: The proposed preceding-two-field antecedent rate does not by itself distinguish anaphoric meaning from a temporal or lexical rival. An anaphoric use may be exophoric, implicit in the situation, bound farther back than two fields, or carried by a prior result rather than a typed source item. Conversely, a temporal or lexical item can be concentrated after a setup field because discourse order itself creates a local predecessor. Both models can therefore generate the same compatible-antecedent rate and continuation-slot rate.
countermodel: Suppose a reference-like whole normally points to an implicit vessel established earlier in the paragraph, while the two preceding fields contain only an operation and quantity. The anaphoric model predicts no locally compatible antecedent in the proposed window. Now suppose the temporal rival is conventionally placed after a preparation field; it predicts a high local antecedent-like rate even though no reference relation exists. The observed contingency table is identical under both models.
not_general_invalidity: The design is not generally useless. It becomes a meaningful bounded test only if its additional independence assumptions are fixed before coding.
required_compound_assumptions: The two-field window is independently justified as the complete admissible antecedent domain for this candidate and register; farther-back, exophoric, implicit, and result-antecedent cases are separately coded rather than counted as absent.
A compatible antecedent is operationalized from independently typed source/result roles, with provenance and coder agreement recorded before candidate outcomes are inspected.

Temporal/lexical rival placement is independently matched on register, line/field position, record type, and opportunity to carry a prior item; otherwise discourse order can create the same rate difference.
Continuation slots have a fixed definition independent of the candidate gloss, and missing, ambiguous, and unavailable antecedents are not collapsed into negative evidence.
The candidate set and matched controls are frozen before coding, with a held record split and an explicit comparison of local, farther-back, implicit, and exophoric antecedent classes.
legitimate_prediction: Conditional on those assumptions, anaphoric candidates should show a preregistered excess of independently typed compatible antecedents and reference-continuation slots over matched temporal/lexical controls, surviving register and position strata. Failure of that conditional contrast falsifies the bounded local-anaphoric mechanism; it does not falsify anaphoric meaning generally.
smallest_reopen: First resolve the IDEA000023 versus hc6 identity mismatch. Then preregister a provenance-clean two-coder antecedent scheme with a justified window and explicit nonlocal/exophoric categories; only after that is the proposed rate comparison scientifically discriminating.
